steps.name: a_hover_stall
steps.desc: pointer over a market stall: bare chalk ring on the stall (no wash), the plaza ring faded, the 16 px pill and the hint bar chips (Drag Move piece, Q E Turn piece, R Re-roll, Del Remove)

steps.name: b_picked_stall
steps.desc: clicked: bare gold ring, the pane has a rule and a heading-weight Market stall title above Swap and Remove

steps.name: c_turned_stall
steps.desc: Q three times over the picked stall: turned 45 degrees, pinned (the pane offers Back to its spot)

steps.name: d_swapped
steps.desc: the pane's Swap button pressed: the stall is now another prop of a plaza's edge

steps.name: d2_rerolled
steps.desc: R over the picked piece: another draw of the same prop (the next of its four variants), pinned

steps.name: e0_carry_mid
steps.desc: mid-drag over the plaza: the real piece has left its spot, a translucent copy is carried at the pointer, the place it left a calm ring, gold ring and the pill Release to put it here

steps.name: e_carry_ghost
steps.desc: further along, still inside the plaza: ghost at 0.55 transparency, no piece left at its old spot

steps.name: f_dropped
steps.desc: released inside the plaza: the piece stands where it was put

steps.name: g1_outside_refused
steps.desc: dragging a plaza piece out past the plaza ring: the chalk-pink 2.5 px ring over its ink outline, no wash, the faint copy, the pill Keep it inside the plaza

steps.name: g2_after_outside
steps.desc: after the refused release: the stall is back where it was, the toast says why

steps.name: g_refused
steps.desc: dragging a bench over a house: the same pink ring, no cross or second ring, the copy faint, the pill says why

steps.name: h_after_refusal
steps.desc: the frame after the refused release: nothing moved, the toast tells why

steps.name: i_toast_cleared
steps.desc: seven seconds and a successful turn later: the refusal toast has cleared

steps.name: j_hover_lamp
steps.desc: pointer over a lamp post

steps.name: k0_barrel_before
steps.desc: close on a barrel, the pointer over it: the ring and the pill (the BEFORE of a removal)

steps.name: k1_barrel_removed
steps.desc: Delete: the barrel is gone, the toast says Removed barrel with Put back, the pane offers Put back 1 removed piece

steps.name: k2_put_back_preview
steps.desc: the pointer over Put back 1 removed piece: a ring and a faint copy of the barrel stand where it will return

steps.name: k3_put_back_result
steps.desc: Put back pressed: the barrel stands again, the pane has no restore button

steps.name: k3b_removed_again
steps.desc: the barrel removed a second time: its toast is up again

steps.name: k4_pane_put_back_clears_toast
steps.desc: the pane's Put back pressed (not the toast's): the barrel is back and the toast has gone with it

steps.name: l_720_piece_pane
steps.desc: 1280x720: a picked piece with the pointer over it: the 16 px pill, the piece box with its rule, heading and Swap / Remove, whole pane in view

steps.name: m_720_toast_centre
steps.desc: 1280x720: a removal toast over the hint bar, for the centre-line measurement

steps.title: villages4 look
steps.intro: Touchable furnishings in the Village tool
